seoCopy: Emerald Jhumka Elegance pairs an emerald-green base with repeated gold oval motifs, embellished sleeve cuffs and jhumka-style tassels at the back. The listed work combines Aari-style gold embroidery, beadwork and decorative tassels; the exact bead and thread materials can be confirmed during your enquiry. The rounded neckline and repeated oval borders give the front a clear focal point, while the U-shaped back and tassels carry the motif through to the reverse. Emerald, bottle green, red, cream and gold sarees are possible pairings, depending on the saree border, pallu and jewellery. Bring a daylight photo or the saree itself so colours can be considered together rather than matched from a screen. The listed starting price is ₹4,999 for hand embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment; the garment, courier and additional material changes are separate. Share your event date and garment readiness, and the studio will confirm a realistic timeline after reviewing the final work and current schedule.
summary: An emerald green blouse with ornate gold oval borders, scattered motifs and traditional jhumka-style back tassels.
description: The front showcases a rounded neckline framed by repeated gold oval motifs, with matching embellished sleeve cuffs and a coordinated lower border. The back features a wide U-shaped neckline, scalloped oval embroidery, tie strings and paired jhumka-style tassels. The rich green-and-gold palette gives the design a traditional festive and bridal feel.

faqs.q: What occasion is Emerald Jhumka Elegance best for?
faqs.a: Engagements, receptions, sangeet and festive family functions. The jhumka tassels on the back and the gold oval motifs give a traditional look without full bridal weight.

faqs.q: Which sarees go well with Emerald Jhumka Elegance?
faqs.a: Bottle green, emerald, gold and warm cream silk match it most naturally. A bright red or deep maroon saree makes the gold ovals stand out. Send us a daylight photo of your saree and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: Can I keep the tassels but change the back neckline?
faqs.a: Yes. The jhumka tassels can be added to most back necklines. Tell us the shape you want and we will confirm how the oval border will sit around it.

faqs.q: Can you change the colours or motifs on Emerald Jhumka Elegance?
faqs.a: Yes. Most brides change something: the thread colour to match their saree, a denser or lighter fill, or a different neckline and sleeve finish. Send your saree photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you what works and whether it changes the price.

faqs.q: How do I order Emerald Jhumka Elegance?
faqs.a: Tap WhatsApp or Make It Yours and send your saree photo and event date. We confirm the design, price, courier charge and delivery date. You pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse to our Trichy studio, and we send it back by tracked courier once the work is done.
